excludeFromSharedBackgroundFit.name: Volcanic Island
excludeFromSharedBackgroundFit.reason: User compared independent online scans and identified the cached Scryfall scan as abnormally dark. One cached scan cannot establish a printing-wide defect.

findings: The outer colored strip is restored from the selected source plate, not drawn as a hardcoded pure-black fill.

The shared post-HSB texture curve subtracts up to 25.5 red/27.56 blue levels in mid-dark values. Removing it improves the three black outlines but worsens Volcanic Island; do not optimize a shared frame against this dark outlier.
Raising all B pigment rings affects more than the full-frame strip. Split the first source-local ring from the remaining art/text rings and adjust it independently.
The structural metric does not independently report this outer pigment strip; color mismatch must be evaluated separately from edge overlap.

candidate.name: combined-nine
candidate.backgroundFitMethod: Equal-card/equal-side L1 of neutral strip median RGB. Per-channel global linear gain is weighted median(target/source), source-channel value as weight. Single gain for nine cards; excludes no side or card except user-identified Volcanic scan.
candidate.scope: Same neutral-background transform for all five dual source plates; paper/textbox transformations and geometry unchanged.
candidate.blackOuterOnlyIsolation: Seven other duals byte-identical under outer-only correction; only Badlands, Bayou and Underground Sea change. Combined background fit intentionally changes all ten backgrounds, including Volcanic Island using the nine-card rule.

colorDiagnostic.method: RGB mean absolute error after Gaussian sigma1.5 native pixels; side-paper medians fit with equal card/side weighting. Native fixed scan poses; no rescaling, rotation, text or per-card fit changes.
colorDiagnostic.coverage: Two neutral side strips only; separate left shadow/keyline diagnostics. This is not certification of all frame colors or full-card accuracy.
